notes.general_comments:
2754 candidates took this 30 question multiple-choice examination and the mean score was 20.2 which was
higher than the mean score of 19.7 in 2017.
The questions for which most candidates selected the correct answer were 1, 2, 9, 11, 15, 20, 22, 23 and 26.
These questions were answered correctly by 80% or more of the candidates. They covered different parts of
the syllabus and were set to test different skills.
The questions for which the fewest candidates selected the correct answer were 5, 21 and 29. These
questions were answered correctly by 50% or fewer candidates. The rest of the questions gave results which
were well within the levels expected.
